SELECT  
CLM.CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
MST.TCL_TYPE_DESC		AS "Encounter Current Status",
MAX.CRS_ADD_TS			AS "Encounter Status Date"

FROM 		HS.CLM_CLAIM		AS CLM
JOIN        	HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN		HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS MAX ON CLM.CLM_ID = MAX.CRS_CLM_ID AND MAX.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND ((MAX.CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') /*AND MAX.CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')*/) OR MAX.CRS_TYPE IN ('096','097','098','060','061','062','095','059','026','077')) --uncomment for Sanford
									AND MAX.CRS_ADD_TS = (SELECT CRS_ADD_TS FROM HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT WHERE CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND ((CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') /*AND CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')*/) OR CRS_TYPE IN ('096','097','098','060','061','062','095','059','026','077')) 
													AND MAX.CRS_CLM_ID = CRS_CLM_ID ORDER BY CRS_ADD_TS DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)
LEFT JOIN		HS.TCL_TYPE_CD_LOOKUP AS MST ON MAX.CRS_TYPE = MST.TCL_TYPE_CODE AND MST.TCL_ID = 156

WITH UR
